scope: Use the existing 18 queue-dominated >10s independent waits; this is not the full prefetch population.
Native arrival comes from the sealed whole-request attribution and service-minus-queue interval.
Protection release is not physical eviction; do not treat released bytes as wasted or resident.
Missing priority-admission records do not prove no planning/priority attempts or a particular queue rank.
Opportunity samples are sparse and input-unverified; absence does not establish readiness.
Legacy native reload pool presence does not prove exact page/component reloading or causal delay.
Do not extend leases or change admission quotas from this cohort alone; no runtime policy changed.
